title: Why Does Your Stomach Growl?
short_title: Why Your Stomach Growls (It's Not Only Hunger)
description: Why does your stomach growl, and is it only when you are hungry? Here is the simple science.
comment: When does your stomach growl the most? 😅

scenes.text: Why does your stomach growl, and is it only when you are hungry?
Your stomach and gut are muscle tubes. They squeeze food forward in waves.
When the tube is empty, the waves still keep going, and gas and liquid move around inside.
In a hollow tube, that sound echoes loudly. The science name is borborygmi.
So growling is normal. It is not a perfect hunger signal, because it also happens after meals.
